RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
string
The unique ID of your Tenable Vulnerability Management instance.
string
The unique ID of the OT connector.
string
The OT connectors name.
string
The sensor type. This value is always ot  for OT connectors.
string
The OT connector's type. There are two types of OT connectors,
Industrial Core Platform (ICP) and Enterprise Manager (EM).
integer <int64>
The Unix timestamp of when the OT connector was created.
integer <int64>
The Unix timestamp of when the OT connector was last modified.
integer <int64>
The Unix timestamp of when the OT connector was last authenticated.
boolean
Indicates whether or not the OT connector is enabled.
— 400 Returned if the OT connector id or type is missing or invalid.
— 403 Returned if you do not have permission to view the OT connector.
— 404 Returned if the specified OT connector id doesn't exist.
500
Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management encountered an error while attempting to retrieve the
OT connector details.
